definition.def: Concentration on something involves giving all your attention to it.
examples: Neal kept interrupting, breaking my concentration.
We lacked concentration and it cost us the goal and the game.

definition.def: A concentration of something is a large amount of it or large numbers of it in a small area.
examples: The area has one of the world's greatest concentrations of wildlife. [+ of]
There's been too much concentration of power in the hands of central authorities. [+ of]

definition.def: The concentration of a substance is the proportion of essential ingredients or substances in it.
examples: pH is a measure of the concentration of free hydrogen atoms in a solution. [+ of]
Global ozone concentrations have dropped over the last decade.
